#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
const int twoPow = 23;
const int ROOT = 15311432;

int bitReverse(int n, int k) {
    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        res = (res << 1) | (n & 1);
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long modPow(long long a, long long p) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long base = a % MOD;
    while (p > 0) {
        if (p & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        p >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

long long modInv(long long a) {
    return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
}

vector<long long> calcRoots(int k, bool inverse) {
    long long root = modPow(ROOT, (1LL << twoPow - k));
    if (inverse) {
        root = modInv(root);
    }
    vector<long long> roots(k);
    if (k > 0) {
        roots[k - 1] = root;
    }
    for (int i = k - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        roots[i - 1] = (roots[i] * roots[i]) % MOD;
    }
    return roots;
}

vector<long long> reorderArray(const vector<long long>& a, int k) {
    int n = a.size();
    vector<long long> ans(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        ans[bitReverse(i, k)] = a[i];
    }
    return ans;
}

vector<long long> numberTheoreticTransform(vector<long long> coef, int k, bool inverse) {
    coef = reorderArray(coef, k);
    vector<long long> roots = calcRoots(k, inverse);
    for (int s = 0; s < k; s++) {
        int len = 1 << s;
        for (int st = 0; st < (int)coef.size(); st += 2 * len) {
            long long curRoot = 1;
            for (int j = st; j < st + len; j++) {
                long long t = (curRoot * coef[j + len]) % MOD;
                long long u = coef[j];
                coef[j] = (u + t) % MOD;
                coef[j + len] = (u - t + MOD) % MOD;
                curRoot = (roots[s] * curRoot) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return coef;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n_input, m;
    cin >> n_input >> m;
    int n = n_input / 2;
    vector<int> nums(m);
    int maxVal = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        cin >> nums[i];
        maxVal = max(maxVal, nums[i]);
    }
    int min_size = n * maxVal + 1;
    int size = 1, k = 0;
    while (size < min_size) {
        size <<= 1;
        k++;
    }
    vector<long long> a(size, 0);
    for (int num : nums) {
        a[num] = 1;
    }
    a = numberTheoreticTransform(a, k, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        a[i] = modPow(a[i], n);
    }
    a = numberTheoreticTransform(a, k, true);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        ans = (ans + a[i] * a[i]) % MOD;
    }
    long long multiplier = modInv(size);
    cout << (((ans * multiplier) % MOD) * multiplier) % MOD << "\n";
    return 0;
}
